GameplayEvent Rules3 sections
Event Rules

◆ During the event, Transcenders can earn event points by completing the tasks in the task list.

◆ Tasks can be completed repeatedly. Some special tasks have a completion limit.

◆ When the event points reach a certain number, Transcenders can claim point rewards.

Ranking Rewards

◆ Transcenders are ranked based on the points they earned during the event.

◆ Ranking rewards will be claimable after the event ends.

Extra Rule

◆ The event points will be cleared after the event ends.

Unclaimed point rewards will be sent to Transcenders via email.
